entities.summary: St. Matthew's University (SMU) is a private medical school located on Grand Cayman, Cayman Islands in the Caribbean. SMU has a School of Medicine and a School of Veterinary Medicine, which confer Doctor of Medicine (MD) and Doctor of Veterinary Medicine (DVM) degrees, respectively. Matthew's University is owned by Global University Systems, which also owns Saba University School of Medicine and Medical University of the Americas.
